mapper.select: SELECT u.total_users, u.today_new_users, u.verified_users, u.active_users_7d, u.active_users_30d, c.total_contracts, c.today_new_contracts, c.overdue_contracts, c.total_contract_amount, p.total_pay_success, p.today_pay_amount, p.month_pay_amount FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_users, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS today_new_users, SUM(CASE WHEN verified = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verified_users, SUM(CASE WHEN login_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_users_7d, SUM(CASE WHEN login_date >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_users_30d FROM system_users WHERE deleted = 0) u, (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_contracts, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS today_new_contracts, SUM(CASE WHEN end_date < CURDATE() AND status NOT IN (3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_contracts, COALESCE(SUM(salary), 0) AS total_contract_amount FROM custom_contract WHERE deleted = 0) c, (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_pay_success, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 10 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN price ELSE 0 END), 0) / 100 AS today_pay_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 10 AND create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01') THEN price ELSE 0 END), 0) / 100 AS month_pay_amount FROM pay_order WHERE deleted = 0) p

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM system_users WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS count FROM system_login_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND result = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
SELECT HOUR(create_time) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS count FROM system_login_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND result = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY HOUR(create_time) ORDER BY hour

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waiting_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_orders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 10 THEN price ELSE 0 END), 0) / 100 AS total_success_amount FROM pay_order WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 10 THEN price ELSE 0 END), 0) / 100 AS success_amount FROM pay_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 13 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN verified = 0 OR verified IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unverified, SUM(CASE WHEN verified = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verified FROM system_users WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN end_date < CURDATE() AND status NOT IN (3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_contracts, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN end_date < CURDATE() AND status NOT IN (3,4) THEN salary END), 0) AS overdue_amount FROM custom_contract WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT COALESCE(d.label, CONCAT('状态', c.status)) AS name, COUNT(*) AS value, COALESCE(SUM(c.salary), 0) AS amount FROM custom_contract c LEFT JOIN system_dict_data d ON d.value = CAST(c.status AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND d.dict_type = 'contract_status' AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.status, d.label ORDER BY c.status

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(salary), 0) AS amount FROM custom_contract WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 29 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
